verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a chat platform with a REST API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents the REST API, a bot framework, the Botserver and a server installer script, but never an official command-line client for users or agents. Those are developer building blocks or server-admin tooling, not an official CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
